Findings.title: Unproven persistence becomes primary success and destroys recovery
Findings.evidence: plugins/core/lib-ps/repl-invoke.ps1:1558-1590 defaults missing result/persisted to true and clears the failsafe. Native-function probes empty-success-envelope, unrelated-success-envelope, wrong-identity-success and persisted-and-degraded each return true/code=persisted and clear the only recovery record.
Findings.impact: An empty, unrelated, wrong-identity or contradictory successful child reply can erase the only recoverable payload and report a durable write. This failure needs no P6 server-readback requirement to establish it.

Findings.title: Deduplication drops another session payload and changed dialog content
Findings.evidence: repl-invoke.ps1:1466-1489 omits sourceType/sessionId/workspace and ProcessingDialog from the fingerprint. The real Find-ReplFailsafeByFingerprint matches method/hash only. cross-session-queue-dedupe retains only session-A, makes one remote call across A+B, and reports B queued using A recovery. changed-processing-dialog-dedupe makes only one remote call for different dialog payloads.
Findings.impact: Distinct logical writes can be suppressed as unchanged or falsely represented as retained. A shared workspace/agent failsafe directory does not make session/request identity interchangeable.

Findings.title: beginTurn rebinds session A to B and infers durability from a missing flag
Findings.evidence: repl-invoke.ps1:1953,1973-1975,1993,2045-2055. begin-rebinds-local-turn-without-durability-proof starts with cached session-A/req-R and session-state B; actual begin function rewrites the turn to B and submits with neither PlanFile nor TodoId bound.
Findings.impact: A local matching request plus absent degraded flag is treated as a durable reopen, without proof of the exact bound identity. This violates immutable identity and first-persistence metadata rules.

Findings.title: updateTurn and appendDialog ignore conflicting caller request IDs
Findings.evidence: repl-invoke.ps1:2184-2228 and 2274-2333 use the cached request without rejecting a supplied different request. update-ignores-caller-request-and-explicit-metadata writes the caller response to req-R and mutates cache after req-OTHER was supplied. dialog-ignores-caller-request calls the remote boundary for req-R and increments auditDialog to 1 after req-OTHER.
Findings.impact: The appendActions-only mismatch test does not establish the all-mutation AC. Wrong-turn writes remain possible.

Findings.title: Explicit update metadata is ignored at cache and payload boundaries
Findings.evidence: repl-invoke.ps1:2284-2333 never reads planFile/todoId from updateTurn parameters. The update probe sends plan-NEW/todo-NEW, retains plan-A/todo-A, and calls persistence with both metadata parameters unbound.
Findings.impact: The explicit-to-cache-to-None contract is not implemented across the claimed update path.

Findings.title: Degraded missing-turn dialog skips the required recovery attempt
Findings.evidence: repl-invoke.ps1:2234-2265 directly queues the dialog after degraded 404. degraded-404-no-recovery-submit observes one AppendDialog call, zero recovery Submit calls, and one retained dialog record. Existing SessionLogLifecycle.Tests.ps1:121 only asserts queuing.
Findings.impact: The bounded recovery-submit behavior required by the plan and criterion is absent; queuing alone does not prove it.

Findings.title: Degraded prompt-hook output omits the retained recovery path
Findings.evidence: plugins/core/lib-ps/plugin-hook.ps1:903-916 emits status, turnRequestId and additionalContext, with no recovery-artifact path. This file is unchanged by P2. The governing FR-001 AC002 explicitly requires identifying the retained artifact.
Findings.impact: The required diagnostic contract is incomplete even though the degraded status string exists.

Findings.title: BUG-TRIAGE-246 JSON example is malformed and its proof bypasses the defect
Findings.evidence: docs/context/module-bootstrap.md:64-68 places explanatory Markdown inside the JSON fence. Full-fence parsing fails: Additional text encountered after finished reading JSON content. SessionLogP2Contracts.Tests.ps1:511-517 parses only individual method lines; lines 526-535 regex-match YAML text instead of fully parsing fenced examples.
Findings.impact: The amended documents contain the expected words, but one executable example is invalid. The P0 R3 acceptance row required exhaustive fenced-example parsing and parse errors to fail.
